description: This file declares classes and functions related to the QUIC stream factory in the Chromium networking stack, including session management, request handling, and network change responses.

classes.name: QuicStreamRequest
classes.description: Represents a pending request for a QUIC client session, managing request lifecycle and callbacks.

classes.name: QuicStreamFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for managing QUIC sessions, handling requests, network changes, and session lifecycle.

classes.name: QuicSessionAliasKey
classes.description: Encapsulates a session's destination and session key, used for session aliasing and identification.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Initiates a request for a QUIC session with specified parameters.

methods.name: WaitForHostResolution
methods.description: Blocks until host resolution completes or is pending, and sets a callback.

methods.name: OnHostResolutionComplete
methods.description: Called when host resolution completes asynchronously.

methods.name: WaitForQuicSessionCreation
methods.description: Blocks until QUIC session creation completes or is pending, and sets a callback.

methods.name: OnQuicSessionCreationComplete
methods.description: Called when QUIC session creation completes asynchronously.

methods.name: CanUseExistingSession
methods.description: Checks if an existing session can be reused for a given session key and destination.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Begins the process of creating or fetching a QUIC session for a given destination.

methods.name: OnSessionGoingAway
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a session is going away.

methods.name: OnSessionClosed
methods.description: Handles cleanup after a session shuts down.

methods.name: CloseAllSessions
methods.description: Closes all active QUIC sessions with specified error codes.
